item.title: expert reaction to a study looking at the effects of e-cigarette use on pulmonary function
item.description: A new pilot study suggesting that prolonged vaping may affect lung function has drawn criticism from independent experts over significant methodological limitations. (Published on November 13, 2026bysciencemediacentre.org)
